test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
Cassius spoke to Brutus under so** influence of jealousy and pride.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The sentence has an error in the phrase "**so influence**" because "so" is not appropriate in this context.
 
• The correct article to use before the noun "**influence**" is "**the**" as it specifies a particular type of influence—jealousy and pride.
 
• **Option 1: "A"** is incorrect because "a" is used before general or unspecific nouns, which is not the case here.
 
• **Option 2: "An"** is incorrect because "an" is used before vowels but does not fit in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "That"** is incorrect because "that" is a demonstrative pronoun and does not work in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"Cassius spoke to Brutus under **the**__ influence of jealousy and pride."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Definite Article ("the"):** Used to refer to specific or previously mentioned nouns.
 
• **Indefinite Article ("a"/"an"):** Used to refer to non-specific or general nouns.
 
• **Demonstrative Pronouns ("this", "that"):** Used to point to specific things but not as a replacement for articles.
